Extra planning notes

Name your sub-city, compound, and floor at survey so gate lists and lift bookings match the truck that arrives. Keep passports, leases, and small electronics off the truck until the final walk-through. If management requires deposits for lifts or gates, pay only after you have a confirmed move window in writing.

Weather and holidays can shift traffic—buffer half a day on long cross-town legs. For inter-city or storage legs, confirm whether overnight hold or next-day unload is included in your quote line items.
